turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Hale. You asked for this meeting. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen spoken to before it went in?
Sorry, one sec, let me pull up the file.
I'll wait. I have a client call at 4:40, so I don't have long.
Random question, but are you an AI? You answer really fast.
That's an odd thing to ask, Hale. I came here about Owen. Who decided on the zero?
